name: The Red Ballet: Stitches
source:
A new VHS tape was left behind, ready to played.

Another night. Another client. Awa can't make herself knock on the hotel room door.

She stitches a smile onto her face. She knocks. The client opens the door.

Another night. Another stitch.

[From [url=https://pinknarcissus.itch.io/the-red-ballet-stitches]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
留下了一盘新的VHS磁带，准备播放。

又一个晚上。另一个客户。阿瓦无法让自己敲响酒店房间的门。

她脸上露出微笑。她敲门。客户打开门。

又一个晚上。又一针。

[来自[url=https://pinknarcissus.itch.io/the-red-ballet-stitches]Itch.io[/url]]
